title: Innovator's Journey (Greater Irvine Chamber of Commerce Event)
snippet: Join the Greater Irvine Chamber for an immersive executive experience featuring visionary leaders who are shaping the future of mobility, technology, healthcare, entrepreneurship, and artificial intelligence. Keynote speaker Errol Arkilic, Chief Innovation Officer at UC Irvine and Executive Director of UCI Beall Applied Innovation, will explore the complete innovation lifecycle.
match_reason: websearch (talk) — Errol Arkilic is the featured Keynote Speaker at this event discussing the innovation lifecycle, which includes artificial intelligence.
